message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a magazine cover for "TEMPO". The top section features a red banner with white and black text, including headlines like "Teror untuk Penentang UU TNI" and "Omon-omon Menghapus Kuota Impor". Below the red "TEMPO" masthead, a large headline reads "MAKAN-MAKAN BERGIZI GRATIS" in bold white capital letters.

The central scene is an illustration of six men seated behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth. They are arranged in a horizontal line, reminiscent of "The Last Supper" composition. The men have light skin and dark hair; five wear light green long-sleeved shirts, while one wears a dark jacket. They are engaged in various actions: several hold smartphones to their ears or in front of their faces, one wipes his mouth with a white napkin, and one leans forward looking at a phone. A small, calico cat sits on the table in front of the central figure.

On the table are several light-blue divided meal trays, clear glasses of water, and crumpled white napkins. The setting is an indoor structure with wooden floors, pillars, and a glowing, circular ceiling light. The bottom right corner contains publication details, a barcode, and a QR code.
